notes: TOC132 / AT3G16620 TOC120 / AT5G20300 TOC90: TOC159 receptor family members.
TOC75-III: main protein-conducting Omp85 channel of the outer envelope. Symbol alias 'TOC75' collides with OEP80/AT5G19620 (a different beta-barrel); resolved to AT3G46740.
TOC34: outer-envelope import receptor GTPase (paralog of TOC33).
TOC33: outer-envelope import receptor GTPase. Alias 'PPI1' collides with 'proton pump interactor 1' AT4G27500; resolved to AT1G02280.
TIC100: inner-membrane 1MDa TIC complex. NOTE: distinct from EMB2794/AT2G02150 (a mygene 'TIC100' collision that was dropped).
LHCB1.3 (CAB1): LHCII apoprotein — photosynthesis proliferation marker.
RBCS1A: Rubisco small subunit — nuclear-encoded photosynthesis proliferation marker (not import/division machinery).
RBCS2B: Rubisco small subunit — proliferation marker.
ARC5/DRP5B: dynamin-related plastid-division GTPase. CROSS-NOTE: shared with peroxisome division machinery (DRP5B divides both plastids and peroxisomes).
